coefficients.workload: 0.60 × last-five mean opportunity + 0.40 × last-twenty mean opportunity
coefficients.efficiency: 0.40 × last-five pooled production/opportunity + 0.60 × last-twenty pooled production/opportunity

formulaMap.fallbacks: No numerical fallback. Fewer than eight complete same-team games, nonpositive opportunity, stale/missing roster/depth, injuries, missing rolling errors, or a baseline failure blocks issuance.
formulaMap.injuryAdjustment: No point adjustment; injury evidence adds a blocking reason.
formulaMap.roleAssumption: First-listed depth role is required for issuance but does not change the numeric projection.
formulaMap.marketInput: None in point projection. Exact prop line is used only after projection as an external benchmark.
formulaMap.probability: Smoothed empirical rolling production errors with one pseudocount per possible outcome; explicitly uncalibrated.

sources.provider: ESPN public game logs and final summaries
sources.use: Earlier final opportunity features and final target counts; revised data, not a preserved pregame role feed.
Free diagnostic offense snaps/share; cross-provider name-to-ID mapping and publication timing prevent automatic role proof.

Availability state only; never reconstructed from final participation.

coverage.targetsCarries: Exact player numerator and team denominator present for every accepted row; duplicate receiving views reconciled exactly.

apiImpact.additionalProviderCalls: None. Forward opportunity output reuses the already bounded Phase 2 forecast-input calls; unfetched players remain MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.

evaluation.decision: PLAYER OPPORTUNITY ENGINE BLOCKED BY DATA QUALITY
evaluation.note: Opportunity targets are final box-score counts. Every predictor uses only earlier games. No odds, prices, betting outcomes, or target-game workload enter a prediction.
